name: Carry Your Weight
summary: Atop the watchtower overlooking Razor Hill, Furl Scornbrow asks young Horde adventurers to gather canvas from human and centaur hostiles. Too old for the front lines, the scarred veteran will make supplies to aid their journey.

sections.title: A Veteran's Calling
sections.body: Furl Scornbrow fought beside Warchief Thrall in Durotar and at Mount Hyjal. Age and old injuries have slowed the veteran, and he no longer wields his axe in battle. From the Razor Hill watchtower, Furl keeps a steady vigil and sounds the alarm against incursions. He supports the next generation of defenders from his post.

sections.title: Scavenged Canvas
sections.body: As the Horde's grip on the region tightens, signal horn alerts grow less frequent, leaving Furl more hours to craft practical gear. Sturdy canvas is scarce in Durotar's arid canyons, but the Kul Tiran interlopers along the eastern shore and the nomadic Kolkar centaur roaming the plains carry it in abundance. Canvas scavenged from these hostile forces gives Furl cloth to stitch utility bags for active scouts.

faq.answer: Furl Scornbrow is an aging orc veteran stationed atop the watchtower above Razor Hill. He fought beside Thrall during the founding of Durotar and joined the ranks that defeated Archimonde at Mount Hyjal. Though he can no longer fight on the front lines, Furl keeps watch and crafts field equipment for young Horde warriors.

faq.q: Where can canvas scraps be found in Durotar?
faq.answer: Canvas scraps can be gathered from Kul Tiran humans along Durotar's eastern shore and from nomadic Kolkar centaur roaming the plains. Both carry sturdy canvas that can be salvaged from their belongings.

faq.q: Where is the watchtower where Furl is located?
faq.answer: Furl's watchtower stands on the high rocky bluffs directly northwest of Razor Hill. A winding path behind the settlement climbs to the summit and its wooden lookout.

faq.q: What does Furl craft with the canvas scraps?
aliases: what is the canvas used for
faq.answer: Furl sews the canvas scraps into utility bags for young adventurers traveling across Durotar. The extra carrying space helps them bring provisions, rations, and salvaged arms through the harsh wilderness.

faq.q: Why is an old warrior crafting bags instead of fighting?
aliases: why does furl stay in the tower
faq.answer: Age and old injuries have left Furl unable to match the speed and strength needed in the field. He finds honor in retirement by keeping watch over Razor Hill and crafting gear that helps younger fighters defend the realm.

faq.q: What war did Furl fight in?
faq.answer: Furl fought under Warchief Thrall during the Third War, helping settle Durotar and fighting the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. He joined the temporary, necessary truce between the Horde, the night elves, and the Alliance to defeat Archimonde.

angles.text: As a young Horde soldier in Durotar, you rely on seasoned veterans like Furl Scornbrow. They remind newcomers that honoring the Horde means doing whatever duty the homeland requires, whether guarding an outpost or sewing canvas.

As an orc, you see in Furl an elder who broke free from demonic corruption and crossed the sea with Thrall. Like others of his generation, he dedicates his final years to nurturing the future of his fledgling nation.
As a tailor, you can see Furl's rugged frontier craft in each bag. He turns discarded heavy canvas from human invaders and centaur raiders into durable gear for surviving the wilderness.
